# NeighborhoodGuide - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: NeighborhoodGuide
- Tagline: Neighborhood blurbs that make the location the hero.
- Domain: https://neighborhoodguide.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Given a neighborhood and who's moving there, get a lifestyle-focused description for listings, relocation packets, or your site.
- Lifestyle framing
- Buyer-matched
- Nearby highlights
- Relocation-ready

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 4 blurbs/mo
- **Pro** — $15/mo — Unlimited, save history
- Checkout: https://neighborhoodguide.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://neighborhoodguide.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Do I need to install anything?
A1. No. NeighborhoodGuide runs in your browser.
Q2. Is my input kept private?
A2. We use it only to generate your result and minimize retention. See Security.
Q3. Does it guarantee compliance / correctness?
A3. No. It is decision-support; you own the final call. See the honesty note in Security.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON and CSV.
Q5. Is there an API?
A5. Yes, the web form is backed by a REST endpoint you can call from your pipeline.

## Key pages
- Home / landing: https://neighborhoodguide.lxsaihub.com/

- Web app (Next.js) deployed on Vercel
- Payments via Waffo Pancake (merchant of record)
- Analytics via Umami
